turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good morning, Mr. Tan. I'm Dr. Lim from the anesthesia team. We'll be discussing your upcoming surgery and anesthesia plan. How are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Morning, Doctor. I'm okay lah, just a bit nervous about the operation. But ready to get this gallbladder issue sorted.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Understandable. Let's start with your medical history. Can you tell me about your gallbladder problem?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Yes, I had bad pain on the right side last month, and the scan showed stones. Doctor said it's best to remove it laparoscopically.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thank you. Now, let's go through your medications. Can you list what you're currently taking?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Sure. I take Amlodipine 5mg every morning for blood pressure, Metoprolol 50mg daily for the same, Metformin 500mg twice a day for diabetes, Atorvastatin 20mg at night for cholesterol, and Aspirin 75mg daily. Oh, and I stopped Levothyroxine already.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: You mentioned stopping Levothyroxine—when was that, and why did you stop?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: About a year ago, Doctor. The thyroid tests came back normal, so my GP said I don't need it anymore. Records might still show it, but I haven't taken it since.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Important to update that. Any allergies to medications or other substances?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No allergies, Doctor. Never had any reactions.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Great. Have you had any previous surgeries or anesthesia? Any issues like nausea, breathing problems, or awareness during surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I had a hernia repair 10 years back. Anesthesia was smooth, no problems at all. Recovered well.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Excellent. How's your diabetes control? Any recent episodes of low or high sugar?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Stable lah, Doctor. Fasting sugar usually around 6-7 mmol/L. No hypos recently.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good. Are you on a normal diet now? And when did you last eat or drink?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Yes, normal food. I had dinner at 8pm last night, and water until 10pm. No solids after that.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Perfect. Lastly, how's your general fitness? Can you climb stairs or walk without difficulty?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No problem, Doctor. I walk 30 minutes most days and can take the stairs without stopping.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Tan. We'll proceed with general anesthesia and intubation as planned. I'll review your updated med list and ensure the team knows about the Levothyroxine change.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Thank you, Doctor. Feel better knowing everything's in order.
